description: turboderp/Qwen3.8-27B-exl3 3.00bpw (revision 6fe61ad6, shard sha256s verified) in SGLang v0.5.20 with the sglang-exl3 plugin on one RTX 4090 24 GB. This is the RTX 3090 recipe run unchanged: 204,800-token context, fp8 KV (pool 207,356 tokens), the bf16 token embedding in pinned host memory, NEXTN MTP (3 steps, 4 draft tokens) with the 32k hot-token draft head, and the qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_coder tool parsers. Every CUDA graph is captured and it is ready in about 85 s. Decode per stream at C1, thinking off, 512-token answers, cold unique prompts: code 184 tok/s at empty context, 174 at 19k, 118 at 134k and 115 at 191k; prose 126 / 129 / 91. Cold prefill: 2,112 tok/s at 19k, 1,636 at 134k. Same card and prompts on llama.cpp with UD-Q4_K_XL and MTP: code 116 / 107 / 65 / 52. Tool call (qwen3_coder), reasoning split and vision (solid red and blue PNGs named correctly) checked on this card.

engine.graph_mode: full decode CUDA graphs; prefill graphs off
engine.name: sglang

acceptance.harness: scripts/accept_recipe.py on a bare RTX 4090 24 GB (recipe argv via docker run)

comparison.engine: llama.cpp 2468576f, unsloth Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL, -c 196608, q4_0 KV, --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 --spec-draft-p-min 0.0, same card and prompts via /completion timings

depth_sweep.decode_method: (usage.completion_tokens - 1) / (last content chunk - first content chunk), client-side
depth_sweep.host: bare RTX 4090 24 GB (Ryzen 9 7900X3D host), card otherwise idle; container launched with this recipe's exact argv, environment and mounts
depth_sweep.prefill_method: prompt_tokens / time to first content chunk; cold rows only. Prose rows at depth reused the code row's prefix through the radix cache, so they carry no prefill figure; their decode figures are unaffected. The 190,950-token row also reused a cached prefix, so it carries no prefill figure
depth_sweep.workload: one stream, /v1/chat/completions streamed, thinking off (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false), max_tokens 512, temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, top_k 20. Depth is real prompt tokens: repeated ~19.1k-token blocks of seeded pseudo-code notes followed by one task. code = thread-safe LRU cache with TTL in Python; prose = ~400-word explanation of hybrid linear-attention decode

ported_from.change: none: same image digest, argv, environment and mounts as the RTX 3090 recipe; only hardware_id differs

quantization.kernel: sglang-exl3 Marlin-template EXL3 kernels (K=3, decoded weights bit-identical to exllamav3 reconstruct), 2 blocks per SM; K=6 lm_head on exllamav3_ext; MTP draft on a 32k hot-token bf16 head; token embedding in pinned host memory

tool_check.result: forced-choice get_weather prompt returned one qwen3_coder-parsed tool call with valid JSON arguments and a separate reasoning_content, against the same container accept_recipe.py measured

vision_check.launch: same image digest, argv and mounts; served under a llama-swap model id
vision_check.result: 64x64 solid red and solid blue PNGs sent as image_url data URIs; answered Red and Blue
